scope: Independent read-only semantic and contract review of the House expected-error normalizer, runtime matcher, current forecast projection, client attachment, publication index, UI wording and synthetic importer/runtime tests. No source edits, test reruns, actual corrected16 collection admission, archive decoding/rehashing, result ingestion, grade, or publication.
contractFindings: The frontend keeps two event scopes distinct: 435 district-level candidate/group winner outcomes drive expected modal misses; 412 named conditional principal pairs drive margin-error and interval-coverage metrics; the remaining 23 races explicitly have no conditional-pair error/range value.

House modal ties follow the owner’s exact D/R/O order. A synthetic exact R/O tie confirms R is selected and the former lexicographic outcome-ID choice is rejected. The expected miss mean is sum(1 - max probability); the tie order matters to modal-call identity and the joint miss-count distribution, not to that mean.

Count PMFs are bound to the finite original row count through integer bin reconstruction, total counts, expected mean and inverse-CDF quantiles. Metric units and per-metric linear versus inverse-CDF conventions are checked. Configuration/result fingerprints, race order, pair orientation/IDs, pair mask, group/member calls, row/chain dimensions and no-pair statuses are cross-checked.

The importer requires an independently trusted operator review pin separate from producer roots, cross-binds all16 native configurations, owner collection/receipt, sidecars, source receipts/plans, source science/numerical reviews, per-sidecar independent audits and drivers. The V1 NPZ and V2 segmented-manifest selection/weight semantics are covered by metadata-only tests. V2 index, plan and sidecar manifest pins must agree.

Raw NPZ/NPY payload bytes are deliberately not rehashed or recomputed by this normalizer. The contract delegates raw-array integrity to the exact upstream independent audit and operator review, and the output verification record says so. The source plans/receipts and sidecar receipt still bind the exact archive pins and row law.

The public copy labels all435 winner/group events separately from the412 supported named-pair margin statistics. Group probabilities are not split among candidates. It describes the reference as model-implied and finite-bank, not observed accuracy or a grade; it states no separate transformed-metric precision threshold qualification or quantile precision claim and retains the owner precision note. No cross-model or cross-chamber row matching is claimed.
